documents.title: Claude Project Instructions
documents.description: The de-facto README: pipeline diagram, start commands, key files, 10-language engine-routing table, WSL2 envs + asset paths, render-engine quick guide, agent roster, known fixes applied, kill/restart, and pending work.

documents.title: Studio Runtime Config
documents.description: cloud_apis (heygen/did enabled flags, key slots kept blank) + open_source (musetalk/sadtalker/wav2lip conda env, install path, enabled) + ui_prefs. Keys are loaded from secrets at runtime, never stored here.

documents.title: Agent Roster
documents.description: 4 agents (Tasuke, Maia, Naya, Kaze): voice, voice_speed, photo, avatar_description, per-language voice overrides. Plus kokoro defaults (lang_code, sample_rate 24000) and hallo2 weights/paths for the CLI pipeline.

documents.title: Language Routing
documents.description: 10 languages: lang_code, engine (kokoro vs edge-tts), male/female voices, sample text, status. _engine_notes explains why each language routes where it does.

documents.title: Cloud Secrets (gitignored)
documents.description: DID_API_KEY / HEYGEN_API_KEY for the cloud render engines. Read by _read_secrets(); env vars override. Never committed.

documents.title: Main Gradio App
documents.description: The whole studio (~2400 lines): config/secret loading, voice catalog, TTS (Kokoro + edge-tts), background prep, all render-engine wrappers (LivePortrait/Hallo2/retalking/D-ID/HeyGen/MuseTalk/SadTalker/Wav2Lip), the pipeline_generate orchestrator, portrait helpers, and the gr.Blocks UI launching on :7862.

documents.title: CLI Pipeline
documents.description: Headless Kokoro TTS -> Hallo2 (WSL2) -> MP4 pipeline. Usage: python avatar_pipeline.py <agent> "text"|@script.txt [--no-tts]. Independent of the Gradio app.

documents.title: Scene Pipeline
documents.description: Multi-character movie engine: split_script (manual/ai/hybrid), independent character roster (characters.json + inline tags), render_scene, concat_scenes, run_pipeline generator wired to the Scene tab.

documents.title: Detached Launcher
documents.description: Kills any listener on 7862, launches avatar_studio.py detached, logs to logs/studio.log, verifies the port, tails the log on failure.

documents.title: Studio UI Launcher
documents.description: Starts the Gradio studio via the project .venv and opens http://localhost:7862 in the browser.

documents.title: CLI Pipeline Launcher
documents.description: Windows entry point for avatar_pipeline.py: run_avatar.bat <agent> "text" | @script.txt [--no-tts].

documents.title: Service Installer
documents.description: Self-elevating installer for NSSM service QI_AvatarStudio (demand-start, AppDirectory set, rotating log logs/service.log) using C:\QIH\engine\bin\nssm.exe.

documents.title: WSL Render Helper Scripts
documents.file: run_hallo2.sh / run_hallo2_hq.sh / run_retalking.sh / run_tokyo_times.sh / render_lp_batch.sh / install_retalking.sh
documents.description: WSL2-side helper scripts for Hallo2 (standard + HQ), video-retalking, batch LivePortrait renders, the Tokyo Times demo, and retalking install.

documents.title: Smoke Test (pytest)
documents.description: Liveness probe: skips if :7862 is down, otherwise asserts the Gradio root returns 200. Notes the app has no QI /health,/version,/info endpoints.

documents.title: Language & Routing Tests
documents.description: Validate 10-language TTS routing (Kokoro vs edge-tts), quick routing checks, and edge-tts output. smoke_test.py prints the supported-language table.

documents.title: Diagnostics & Syntax Check
documents.description: diagnose.py dumps env / WSL2 / config state for paste-back debugging; check_syntax.py syntax-checks avatar_studio.py.

documents.title: Voice Generation Utilities
documents.description: One-off Kokoro voice generation, the Tokyo Times demo TTS, and a python-docx session-summary generator.

documents.title: Agent Portraits
documents.description: Source portrait photos per agent (Tasuke Hattori, Naya Patel, Kaze Fujimori). Note: agents.json photo paths don't all match the files present — reconcile pending.

documents.title: Rendered Output
documents.description: All generated WAV + MP4 artifacts (gitignored). allowed_paths for the Gradio server is scoped here. Holds dozens of test renders.

documents.title: Studio Logs
documents.description: studio.log / studio_out.log / studio_err.log from the launcher; service.log from the NSSM service.

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Registry (avatarstudio)
documents.description: Registry entry: id avatarstudio, path C:\1-AI\APPS\AvatarStudio, status active, UI port 7862 (block 7840-7869), family_tier sibling, integrates_with empty, exposes talking-head video generation.

documents.title: QI Service Registry
documents.description: Canonical NSSM service list. QI_AvatarStudio is NOT yet listed here — registration pending (see Future / Operations).

documents.title: QI Ecosystem Map
documents.description: Port table, family map, and integration contracts for the whole QI ecosystem — where Avatar Studio sits relative to Maia, Naya, NEXUS, and the Hive.

documents.title: QI Standards
documents.description: Naming, folder, port, and docs conventions all QI projects follow, referenced by this project's CLAUDE.md.
